name: Companion
description: A companion that follows you, fights at your side, takes orders (follow, stay, attack) and wears gear you give it. G opens its order wheel. Saved per world. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Order wheel key
settings.help: Hold to open the wheel (Follow me, Stay here, Attack, Gear, Dismiss); tap for a click wheel.

settings.label: Key: attack what you look at
Respawn after (seconds)
settings.help: 0 = it stays dead until you summon it again.

settings.label: Faction
settings.help: 11 = PlayerAlly: never hits you, fights at full damage.

settings.label: Body (template GUID)
settings.help: The template the companion is spawned from (Enemy_Vukah_Melee).

settings.label: Stay marker (template GUID)
settings.help: What 'Stay here' places for it to guard. Empty = a barrel.

settings.label: Follow distance (m)
settings.help: 0 = the body's own. Changes every creature of that template, wild ones too.
